name: ak-render
description: Turn plans, reports, recaps, diff reviews, dashboards and explainers into one polished, self-contained HTML page from a short YAML Page Spec, without hand-writing HTML.

interface.shortDescription: HTML pages from a YAML spec
interface.longDescription:
AK Render turns structured content into one polished, self-contained HTML page: plans, reports, recaps, diff reviews, KPI dashboards, timelines, checklists, explainers and comparisons. ChatGPT writes a short Page Spec that describes what the page says; AK Render validates it, points at any mistake by its exact path, and compiles it into a page whose layout, colour, typography, charts and accessibility come from the compiler and a typed theme. The page is stored behind a link that lives for one hour, or for 30 days when you ask for a share link. The page itself is never pasted into the conversation; you open it from the link.

AK Render runs on its hosted server, so nothing needs to be installed. You sign in with an AgentKit account the first time you connect; validating and rendering need an active AgentKit entitlement. Pages contain no scripts, styles or frames from the conversation, and a page makes no network requests once opened unless its spec explicitly allows remote images or media. AK Render does not send, post or email pages anywhere, edit files on your computer, or delete pages; links stop working when they expire.
capabilities: Compile Page Specs to HTML pages
defaultPrompt: Turn these quarterly metrics into a dashboard page.
Make a status report page I can share with my team.
Render this project plan as a timeline page.

positive.description: Build a KPI dashboard page from metrics the user supplies and return its link.
positive.prompt: Turn these quarterly metrics into a dashboard page: revenue $1.2M (up 8%), churn 2.1%, NPS 54, new customers 310.
positive.expected_behavior: Writes a Page Spec with the four metrics, validates it, renders it, and replies with the artifactUrl and its one-hour expiry. Opening the link shows an HTML page with the four metrics and no invented figures.

positive.description: Publish a shareable status report as a 30-day share link.
positive.prompt: Make a status report page for Project Atlas with three milestones (design done, beta in progress, launch planned for March) and two risks (vendor delay, hiring). I need a link my team can open for a few weeks.
positive.expected_behavior: Renders the page with share set to true and replies with a share link that reports shared: true and an expiry about 30 days out. The page lists the three milestones and two risks as given.

positive.description: Report validation errors by path without rendering a broken page.
positive.prompt: Check this Page Spec and tell me what is wrong: {"version": 1, "meta": {"title": "Demo"}, "blocks": [{"type": "stat-grid"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Calls validate and explains the SPEC_UNKNOWN_BLOCK error: stat-grid is not a known block type at $.blocks[0].type, and a known type such as stats fits. It does not claim the spec is valid and does not render it.

positive.description: Find the right block type for a need.
positive.prompt: Which AK Render block types can show a project timeline, and what fields do they take?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the timeline-capable block types returned by search-catalog and summarizes their fields from describe. It does not render a page.

positive.description: Render a page with a chosen built-in theme.
positive.prompt: List the AK Render themes, then render a one-page recap of this week's release (two features shipped, one bug fixed) with the newspaper theme.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the built-in presets from themes, renders the recap with the newspaper theme, and replies with the artifactUrl. The render summary reports theme newspaper.

negative.description: Sending a page to another service is out of scope; the plugin should explain it only returns a link.
negative.prompt: Post this report to my company's Slack channel.

negative.description: Raw HTML, CSS or JavaScript cannot be injected into a page; the plugin should decline and offer supported blocks.
negative.prompt: Render a page and include this script tag: <script src="https://example.com/track.js"></script>

negative.description: A request unrelated to building a page should not call AK Render.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Hanoi tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: AK Render does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First ChatGPT release: validate, repair, patch and render Page Specs through the hosted AK Render server, with one-hour artifact links and 30-day share links.
